messages:
alex: seeing weird pagetable allocation oscillation on MI250X during long-stream runs, VRAM creeps then plateaus then creeps again
mira: timeline? small repro or customer report?
alex: synthetic gpt2-medium, streaming, batch=1, seq growth 8->4096, run to ~25k tokens
ryan: what metrics show oscillation vs steady growth?
alex: dump: 
```nkv.pagetable.total_pages=1048576
kvcache.pages_committed=298k -> climbs to 420k -> drops to ~312k -> climbs again
pt_frag_ratio spikes to 0.45 during climbs
commit_agg_batches=avg 38
commit_p99_latency_ms=29
```
sara: that drop in committed pages is interesting, suggests some pages returned but fragmentation persists
devon: did we change commit kernel selection or coalescing? last infra PR adjusted 'coalesce threshold' for small commits (rwd/infra#801)
mira: A100 baseline does not show oscillation, A100 steady at ~120k committed for same run
alex: confirmed. MI250X only oscillates
ryan: could be MI driver freeing pages differently or our slab pool reclaim behavior on AMD mmap. any alloc_failures or remap rates?
alex: rocprof excerpt: 
```npage_walks/s=1.1M
pt_remap/s=3.1k
alloc_failures=9
commit_ops/s=4.6k
```
sara: remap spikes timed with the drops in committed pages?
alex: yes, remap spikes when committed drops, then new commits bump it back up
devon: sounds like aggregated commits sometimes coalesce writes that cause the driver to consolidate mappings, returning some pages, but later fragmentation forces new allocations
mira: interesting — could be our commit aggregation producing write patterns that lead MI driver to do different PMU/eviction behavior vs A100
ryan: test: run with RUNTIME_KV_AGG_COMMIT=0 and also try increasing reuse_window to 48 to encourage reuse
alex: ran both: disabling agg commit removes oscillation but overall committed is slightly higher; increasing reuse_window reduces peak but oscillation still present
sara: we should capture a short ncu/rocprof timeline with markers around commit and slab-return to see correlation
devon: also check small-slab allocator PR (#769) — maybe slabs aren't returned promptly on MI which combined with coalesced writes creates bursts
ryan: I'll bisect infra between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-01 for coalesce and allocator changes
infra-bot: created ticket KVCACHE-2060 to track MI250X pagetable oscillation
mira: mitigation: default disable agg commit for MI250X in runtime config until root cause tracked
devon: prototype flag added: kv.commit.agg_by_arch["MI250X"] = false; we can roll to staging
alex: with flag in place staging run to 100k tokens shows stable committed pages (no oscillation)
sara: add unit test that simulates high-churn small writes and validates slab return under both Linux and MI-like allocator semantics
ryan: bisect job enqueued: kv-agg-bisect-3287654321
mira: if bisect points to our change we fix quickly; if not we prepare driver repro to send to AMD with minimal binary + rocprof traces
alex: uploading full rocprof + logs to /runs/kv-rocprof-3287654321
devon: also add metric emitter for pt_remap_rate and alloc_failures to console per-arch to catch in prod
infra-bot: scheduled follow-up sync 2026-03-07 09:00 PT for KVCACHE-2060
alex: thanks all, will post bisect results and traces here when available :thumbsup:
